<Heading

  children={"Start an associate's shift"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/associates/{id}/start-shift"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a new AssociateShift roster entry for this shift, with an initial set of certifications, raising AssociateShiftStarted. The associate id is client-supplied and this endpoint is naturally idempotent by that id: calling it twice for the same associate upserts the roster entry rather than erroring (each call still re-raises AssociateShiftStarted and returns 201). The optional siteCode records the canonical site the associate works at (ADR 0034) so the staffing gap can be scoped to a site.

The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1 -- the same identifier warehouse-planning carries as site_id) this associate works at for the shift. Omitted, null or blank all leave the site unknown (null is treated exactly like omitting the field): such an associate counts only in UNSCOPED staffing-gap queries. The code is accepted as given -- this context never validates it against facility-layout. A restart (second call for the same associate) replaces the roster entry, site included.","example":"WH1"}},"example":{"certifications":["pack"],"siteCode":"WH1"},"title":"StartShiftRequest"},"example":{"certifications":["pack"],"siteCode":"WH1"}}}}}
